404.description: Source task missing from selected park

post.description: No quantity is inferred from completed trees. The service freezes only verified completed trees/receipts from a closed task; a partially cancelled rail run can contribute its verified completed trees. Bare completed labels, ongoing tasks, zero completed trees and Xi’an trial tasks are ineligible. One batch per task, including cancelled batches; points/factories must belong to that park. Rain prevents new collection. No real collection, scale, lab or vehicle connection is invoked.

post.description: One transaction checks scope, immutable request identity, CAS revision, shared business stage and relevant event holds. An identical request retry returns the current batch even after later steps. Changed request facts and stale revisions return 409. Rain blocks new collection/departure, including resolved events awaiting recovery; indoor records and already happened arrivals remain recordable. Manual holds require their own explicit resume. Quality hold permits append-only reinspection. Received/cancelled batches and upstream task receipts remain immutable.

post.description: One transaction checks scope, immutable request identity, CAS revision, shared business stage and relevant event holds. An identical request retry returns the current batch even after later steps. Changed request facts and stale revisions return 409. Rain blocks new collection/departure, including resolved events awaiting recovery; indoor records and already happened arrivals remain recordable. Manual holds require their own explicit resume. Quality hold permits append-only reinspection. Received/cancelled batches and upstream task receipts remain immutable.
